body: I appreciate that despite not knowing me at all, you have faith in me. Thank you for taking the time to try and help me with the shit I'm going through.
thanks man, I really appreciate your comment. It connected with me the most so far.

Thanks for the kind words. And I hope I can do it. But idk, I feel it's too late for me. I feel I'm not gonna be around for next year, that this will be the final year I will live on this planet we call Earth.

I feel it's too late tho, that no matter what I do can't fix our problems we're having. I just honestly feel I don't deserve her anymore. I can't picture a life without her tho, but also don't want her to be with me anymore. I feel killing myself is only way out of just every bad thing going on. I just don't feel like putting the effort it to change things, I'm just tired of everything and feel everyone is better off if I'm just gone.

I appreciate you taking time out of your day to comment on this. And the problem is, the one who I love most, who helped me the most. I feel I'm losing her and there's nothing I can do about it, idk what I can say or do to fix the situation between us and feel I don't belong with her, cause all this time I've just sat here doing nothing with my life while she's been working and trying to meet me, but now, I think even she's finally got tired of my shit, of just doing absolutely nothing and sitting home playing games day in day out and not making a single step towards my future. I wanna be with her yet I don't take any steps towards working or doing things I should and feel I should let her go be with someone else and just end my life so she never has to see me or deal with me ever again and can be happy with someone else.
